name: the demo bookshop

tables.books: Catalogue: title, genre, list price in INR, pages, publication year
tables.orders: One row per order line (day as YYYY-MM-DD)
tables.reviews: Star ratings (1-5) with a short text

documents.sql: SELECT r.id, b.title, r.text FROM reviews r JOIN books b ON b.id = r.book_id
SELECT id, title, title || ' (' || genre || ', ' || year || ')' FROM books

examples.question: Best-selling genre by copies
examples.sql: SELECT b.genre, SUM(o.qty) AS copies FROM orders o JOIN books b ON b.id = o.book_id GROUP BY b.genre ORDER BY copies DESC LIMIT 5
